_comment: Show Don't Tell — Owl Studio · extra content
The app ships with a built-in prompt bank and merges this file on top at start-up.
Add prompts by editing this file on GitHub and reloading the app. No build step.
If this file is missing or malformed the app still runs on the built-in bank.
id      : unique string, e.g. 'x-b2-07' (duplicates of built-in ids are ignored)
tell    : the flat abstract sentence to be rewritten
tellWord: the emotion being named, lowercase
context : one or two sentences of scene, so the writer can picture it
hint    : { physical, internal, mental } — one guiding question each
show    : { physical:[], internal:[], mental:[] } — reference lines; at least one layer required
lexicon (optional) tops up the scoring word lists:
Note: do not use raw double quotes inside a JSON string (escape them as \"),
and never leave a trailing comma after the last element.

prompts.context: She opens her desk and finds a birthday card from the whole class.

hint.physical: What does her face and body do first?
hint.mental: How long does it take her to understand?

physical: Her mouth opened and nothing came out of it.
She sat down again without meaning to.
internal: Her heart gave one big thump and then carried on as normal.
mental: It took her three whole seconds to work out that all those names were for her.

prompts.context: Waiting for the bus in the rain with no coat.

hint.physical: What is his body doing to keep warm?
hint.internal: What has gone numb or stiff?
hint.mental: What is he counting or wishing for?

physical: He pulled his sleeves down over his hands and held them shut.
He hopped from foot to foot on the same paving stone.
internal: His fingers had stopped being able to feel the strap of his bag.
mental: He worked out that the bus was four minutes late, then worked it out again.

prompts.tell: He was relieved when it was over.
prompts.context: He has just walked out of a presentation he had been dreading for a fortnight.

hint.physical: What does his body do the moment the door closes?
hint.mental: What does he suddenly notice again?

physical: He leaned against the corridor wall and let his bag slide down his arm.
He laughed at something that was not particularly funny.
internal: The band around his chest came loose one notch at a time.
mental: He noticed, for the first time all morning, that he was extremely hungry.

prompts.tell: She was proud of her brother.
prompts.context: Her younger brother, who never speaks in public, has just read his poem to the whole hall.

hint.physical: What does she do that she would deny doing?
hint.mental: What is she planning to say later?

physical: She clapped a beat longer than everybody else and pretended she had not.
She got her phone up too late and filmed the last four words.
internal: Something rose in her throat and made a nuisance of itself.
mental: She was already deciding exactly how casually she would mention it to him afterwards.

prompts.tell: He was bored in the meeting.
prompts.context: A quarterly review. Slide nineteen of forty-two.

hint.physical: What is he doing that looks like attention?
hint.mental: Where has his mind actually gone?

physical: He nodded at intervals he had calibrated earlier in his career.
He wrote the date at the top of a fresh page and underlined it twice.
internal: A dull weight settled behind his eyes and refused to shift.
mental: Somewhere around slide twelve he had begun mentally rearranging his kitchen.

prompts.context: Six weeks in. They are walking back from somewhere ordinary.

hint.physical: What small physical negotiation is happening?
hint.mental: What has changed about how she plans?

physical: She took the long way back and did not explain why.
Their hands kept arriving at the same place and apologising.
internal: Something under her ribs kept losing its footing.
mental: She caught herself checking whether he would like a restaurant she was not going to for another month.
